_comment: DOUBLER COMBAT PAY -- THE ATTACKER IS NOT A SOURCE (CR 508.1f; Morph INT-16 A/B finding, seed 97000 gi 111 turn 3).
Ignoble Hierarch + Birds of Paradise (both able to attack), Gruul Turf untapped, Stomping Ground in hand; opponent at
19. The real kill: Might of Old Krosa in main (+4/+4 on Hierarch, off Birds), Hierarch attacks alone (exalted +1 = 5),
then Berserk ({G}) and Legion Leadership ({1}{R}) in the declare-attackers step off Gruul Turf + Stomping Ground:
5 x 2 x 2 = 20. The first exact combat payer let the payer TAP the attacker-to-be for a combat cast, so the doubler
target moved to a lesser body and the line read as lost; the turn played Firecat + Berserk for 16 (opponent at 3).
Fixed: DblCombatPayInto holds the best own attacker tapped while it pays (declaring it tapped it).
